sections.label: Cabinet feet
sections.evidence: Black bricks #0–15 form two separated rectangular feet at x=4–8 and x=17–21, beneath the brown cabinet.

sections.label: Cabinet and screen surround
sections.evidence: Brown bricks fill the broad housing at z=3–16 through y=14. Tan and black strips frame its front face at z=1–4, alongside small control shapes.

sections.label: Screen panel
sections.evidence: Light-gray bricks form a thin rectangular panel at z=0–2, x=4–17 and y=5–12, with white and red vertical bands along its edges.

sections.label: Antenna mount and stems
sections.evidence: Black brick #965 completes the top patch at y=15; light-gray bricks #966–967 rise above it at x=9 and x=14.

sections.label: Rear casing
sections.evidence: Dark-gray bricks form a broad rear projection at z=16–20, y=3–13, with stepped shoulders narrowing toward its back edge.

sections.label: Screen color bars
sections.evidence: Yellow, green and blue strips occupy x=7–14 at z=0, y=7–12, above a black lower strip at y=5–6.

sections.label: Antenna and exterior fittings
sections.evidence: Light-gray pieces spread outward at y=17–19 to form paired antenna arms. Other additions occupy the front control area and a black rear tab at z=20.
